incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] billing-metering emitter-heartbeat gap detected in eu1 (lag=205s). Overflagging may be delayed. Pager -> @oncall_sam. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-heartbeat
oncall_sam: On it — grabbing emitter pods and kv-prefix logs. Spawning a quick aggregation check, ETA ~5m.
mira_prod: Noted. Any customer-facing signals yet? csm_zoe, did we get any overage emails or support pings?
csm_zoe: Received one DM from AcmeCorp about an unexpected overage email ~2m ago. I paused outbound notifications for the cohort, collecting affected account IDs now.
billing_eli: Seeing delayed usage batches in the ingest queue. write_ts lagging by ~240s on one emitter shard. Quick log snippet: `emitter.commit_latency_ms=240000`
oncall_sam: Running: `kubectl -n metering logs -l app=emitter --since=10m | grep -i heartbeat` — will post output if I see errors.
incident-bot: Auto-action: created incident INC-2028, severity=P2, responders=[oncall_sam,billing_eli,mira_prod]. Notified on-call rotation.
oncall_sam: Logs show repeated `WARN kv-cache: prefix-miss` and one `ERROR write: transient backpressure`. Restarting consumer for shard-3 (rolling restart).
billing_eli: Also confirming ingestion pipeline backlog spike on eu1-consumer: backlog=18k msgs, inflight consumers=2 (expected 4). Possible autoscaler misfired.
mira_prod: Adding routing fallback to global-read replica for metering reads to reduce tail latency, flipping policy now.
csm_zoe: Posting interim note to AcmeCorp: "We're investigating delayed usage/reporting; billing UI may show transient counts. We'll update in 30m."
eng-manager-raja: Good. If restart doesn't bring backlog down in 10m, plan = 1) scale consumers to 6, 2) enable canary fallback to alternate emitter for 10% traffic, 3) contact legal for any urgent customer disputes. Keep me updated. :thumbsup:
oncall_sam: Restart completed for shard-3, consumer restarted, initial drain rate improving (backlog -> 12k). Continuing monitoring.
billing_eli: Confirming delayed aggregates are trickling in to billing store; no new overage flags for accounts we paused.
mira_prod: Monitoring KPIs: emit_latency and ledger_delta. If ledger_delta > 5m we'll trigger customer notification.
eng-manager-raja: Thanks team — keep channel alive for updates. If customer impact grows switch to P1.
